title: Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer-based Framework for Object Detection and Segmentation
mechanism: DINO detector with denoising queries plus a mask branch from a high-resolution pixel embedding; unified detection and segmentation.
evidence: R: 54.5 AP COCO instance, 59.4 PQ panoptic, 60.8 mIoU ADE20K.
adaptation: Benchmark entry in semantic mode; query denoising may help few-data convergence; same 1/4-res limit for crack; could use inactive regions and crack components as instances.
min_experiment: Single benchmark run under the fixed protocol, 5-fold CV; compare with M2F; no score kill line unless it beats M2F on inactive IoU by > 0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark entry; query denoising may help 478-image convergence; inactive as instances gives an instance-AP view.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Run once under the fixed benchmark protocol (5-fold, 1 seed per fold) vs house; no kill line, baseline only.
